res.ack.banner_body: The guest changed this reservation through self-service. Review it and acknowledge.
res.ack.title: Acknowledge the guest's change
res.addon.balance_note: The booking balance grows by this amount; the guest can pay it online from the booking page or at the hotel.
res.addon.card_hint: Priced on their own when they were added; already included in the locked price above.
res.addon.done_balance: Extras added to {name}. New total {total}, balance due {balance}.
res.addon.expired: The price had expired (30 minutes), so the extras were priced again. Check the price and add them again.
res.addon.intro: The stay stays price-locked. Extras are priced on their own at today's prices, without promotions or coupons, and added to the reservation's total. The booking balance grows by the same amount; the guest pays it online or at the hotel.
res.addon.network_hint: If you are not sure whether they were added, add them again: the same price is never added twice.
res.addon.no_promotions: No promotion or coupon applies to extras added after booking.
res.addon.none: No extras can be added now
res.addon.none_hint: The hotel sells no extras that can be added to this reservation at the moment.
res.addon.none_left: Not enough left on any day of this stay
res.addon.note_hint: Saved in the revision history and the audit trail.
res.addon.price_failed: The extras could not be priced
res.addon.reason.first_room: {name}: charged once per booking, so it can only be added to the booking's first room.
res.addon.reason.not_available: {name}: cannot be added to this reservation.

res.addon.reason.quantity.one: {name}: at most {count} per stay, including what is already booked.
res.addon.reason.quantity.other: {name}: at most {count} per stay, including what is already booked.

res.addon.replayed: These extras had already been added to {name}.
res.addon.repriced: The extras were priced again below. Check the price and add them again.
res.addon.result_hint: Choose extras and price them. Nothing is added until you confirm.
res.addon.title: Add extras to {name}
res.addon.too_late: Too late to add for this stay
res.addon.unknown: It is not known whether the extras were added
res.basis.current_help: Today's contracts, promotions and exchange rates.
res.basis.hint: Which prices should the changed stay be calculated with?
res.basis.historical_sale_date_help: As if sold at a date and time you choose (goodwill, disputes).
res.basis.original_sale_date_help: Whatever was on sale at the original sale ({sale}) — may be another version for new dates.
res.basis.original_version_help: The contract version it was sold on ({version}), with the selling rules of the original sale.
res.basis.title: Pricing basis
res.booking.guest_change: A guest changed one of these reservations through self-service. Open it to acknowledge.
res.booking.title: Booking {name}
res.cancel.body: {guest}, {from} – {to}. The reservation is released and the penalty below is recorded.
res.cancel.title: Cancel {name}?
res.cancel.waive_hint: Price override — recorded in the audit trail with your reason.
res.cmp.addons_removed_hint: These extras are taken off the reservation and no longer charged; the proposed total no longer includes them.
res.cmp.caption: Current and proposed stay
res.cmp.currency_changed: The currency changes from {old} to {neu}, so no difference can be shown.
res.cmp.extras_dropped_hint: No capacity is left for these limited extras on the new dates. If you apply the change, they are removed from the reservation and not charged.
res.detail.not_tex: This reservation was not priced by TEX, so it cannot be re-priced or simulated here.
res.gcr.approve_body: The change is applied at the price the guest was shown. The reservation must not have changed since the request.
res.gcr.close_body: Use this once the money left to the hotel was refunded or settled outside TEX.
res.gcr.contract_stopped: {code} no longer sells: this change cannot be approved at the price the guest was shown. Reject it, or change the reservation yourself.
res.gcr.no_refund_cap: Refunds need the payment.refund permission; you can keep the money as credit on the booking.
res.gcr.refund_pending: A refund is queued and runs automatically.
res.gcr.penalty_terms: Asked inside the rate's cancellation terms: approving it gives up what those terms would charge.
res.gcr.refund_waits: The rest of this refund waits until the refund above is checked.
res.gcr.reject_body: The booking stays as it is.
res.gcr.settlement.credit_on_booking: Kept as credit on the booking
res.gcr.settlement.pay_at_hotel: More to pay at the hotel
res.gcr.settlement.staff: Left to the hotel to refund
res.gcr.settlement_choice: What happens to the money paid above the new total
res.gcr.staff.unknown_refund: The gateway never confirmed refund {refund}: check it there before refunding again.
res.gcr.staff.verify_refund_at_gateway: Refund to verify at the gateway:
res.gcr.subtitle: Changes the guest made on the manage page, and how their money was settled
res.gcr.title: Guest changes
res.gcr.verify_body: The gateway did not answer refund {refund}. Check at the gateway whether it was made, then record what it did: TEX then refunds what the change still owes.
res.gcr.verify_failed: It did not refund: TEX refunds it again from another payment, or hands it to staff
res.gcr.staff_money.refunded: Refunded to the guest outside TEX
res.gcr.staff_money.refunded_hint: TEX records the refund on the booking (a refund made by hand) and takes it off what the guest paid.
res.gcr.staff_money.kept_hint: The money stays on the booking as the guest's credit.
res.list.caption: Reservations
res.list.no_access: Your role cannot view reservations at any of your hotels.
res.list.none_hint: Try other filters or clear them.
res.list.subtitle: Every reservation in your hotels, newest first.
res.mod.apply_failed_hint: The proposal expired (30 minutes), or the price or the reservation moved since you calculated. Review the new proposal and apply again.

res.mod.apply_removes_addons.one: Applying this change removes the add-on: {extras}.

res.mod.drop_hint: They keep the price they were added at. Tick an add-on to remove it with this change; the stay itself is re-priced on the pricing basis below (an original basis keeps the price it was sold at).
res.mod.err_basis_at: Choose the sale date and time.
res.mod.expires_hint: A calculation is valid for 30 minutes.
res.mod.intro: The price is locked. A change is re-priced on the basis you choose, shown next to the current price, and applied only with a reason. Nothing changes until you apply.
res.mod.market_hint: Changing the market can change the contract.
res.mod.options_limited: Room and rate options could not be loaded; you can still change dates, guests and extras.
res.mod.override_invalid: Enter an amount of zero or more.
res.mod.result_hint: Change something above (or pick another pricing basis) and calculate.
res.mod.stale: The form changed after this calculation.
res.mod.title: Modify {name}
res.pay.title: Payments
res.resend.body: The booker receives the booking confirmation again at the e-mail address on the booking, with a new link to view and manage the booking.
res.resend.not_sent: Nothing went out to {email}, for example because no outgoing e-mail account is set up. A new manage link was still created, so the previous link no longer works. Re-send once e-mail works, or give the guest the booking reference.
res.resend.not_sent_title: The e-mail could not be queued
res.resend.old_dead: The previous manage link no longer works.
res.resend.queued_hint: The e-mail is in the outgoing queue, not sent yet. The guest's timeline shows when it has been sent, or why it failed.
res.resend.title: Re-send the confirmation e-mail?
res.resend.warning: The previous manage link stops working immediately. Only the link in this new e-mail will work.
res.rev.subtitle: Every change, who made it and why. Nothing is overwritten.
res.rev.title: Revision history
res.sim.contract_now: This contract is {status} now; this is what it sold at then.
res.sim.readonly: Read-only: nothing is saved or changed.
res.sim.subtitle: What would this exact stay have cost if it had been sold at another moment?
res.sim.title: Historical price simulator
res.snap.title: Locked price
